iut_type: payment terminal with integrated antenna Bluetooth module (Flight Solutions)
customer_question: What tests are needed for Bluetooth SIG qualification for our payment terminal?
question_variants: Are we exempt from Bluetooth testing?
Does our product need RF testing or profile testing?
What test list applies to a product using an antenna-integrated module with no SIG profiles?
actual_issue: The customer's product uses a Bluetooth module with an integrated antenna and does not implement any Bluetooth SIG-defined profiles. This combination triggers full RF test and profile test exemptions.
plain_english_explanation: Bluetooth SIG qualification can require two categories of tests: (1) RF/RF PHY tests (radio performance), and (2) Profile tests (protocol behavior). If a product uses a module that already has an integrated antenna and no antenna connector exposed to the outside, there is no need to test RF performance at the product level — the module's own qualification covers it. Separately, if the product does not implement any SIG-defined profiles (e.g., A2DP, HFP, HOGP, etc.), there are no profile-level tests to run. When both conditions apply — integrated antenna module AND no SIG profiles — the product qualifies with zero additional testing required.
consultant_answer: Because the product uses a module with an integrated antenna (no external antenna connector) and implements no SIG-defined Bluetooth profiles, both RF/RF PHY testing and profile testing are fully exempt. Qualification proceeds directly to registration without any testing at the product level.
decision_logic: RF test exemption: module with integrated antenna means the RF interface is internal and pre-qualified at the module level. Profile test exemption: if the product uses the same Bluetooth Host Stack as the QDID component without adding any new profile ICS support, no product-level profile testing is required. When both exemptions apply simultaneously, no testing at all is needed.
final_recommendation: For products using an integrated-antenna Bluetooth module with no SIG profiles, confirm both exemptions with Allion during the quote phase. Registration proceeds directly after payment without scheduling any test sessions.
risk_if_done_wrong: Incorrectly scheduling tests for an exempt product wastes time and money. Conversely, failing to verify exemption eligibility for a product that does need testing delays qualification.
